Remark
[Improved regularity of the weak solution] ↗ thm:hyperbolic-existence-weak-solution ↗ thm:hyperbolic-energy-estimates 1. ch7:7.2.2-rem-1\group Hyperbolic PDE

The energy estimates sharpen the weak-solution regularity to \[ u\in L^\infty (0,T;H_0^1(U)),\qquad u'\in L^\infty (0,T;L^2(U)),\qquad u''\in L^2(0,T;H^{-1}(U)). \]
